question: What essential Kaula teaching must not be given away indiscriminately?
premises: This essence is linked to the origin of the yoginīs
It is explicitly prohibited from being given
inference: The Kaula essence, the origin of the yoginīs, must not be given out.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of sambhavam to the rest of the line is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: The Kaula essence, the source of the yoginīs, must not be given.
